_comment: Machine-checkable facts about the Subo Public API, mirrored from the app repo (web2/public_api). src/pages/api.astro renders its reference tables from this file, and scripts/check-api-drift.mjs asserts every value here still matches the Python source. Do not hand-edit a value without running `npm run check:api`.

blockTypes.desc: Pick one option. Also covers yes/no.
Free text. The input for AI analysis.
Grants XP, a role or an achievement mid-conversation.
Computes a value from earlier answers.

privacyModes.desc: Admins can see individual answers; other members cannot.
Nobody, including admins, can tie an answer to a member.

webhookHeaders.name: X-Subo-Event
webhookHeaders.desc: The event type, for example response.submitted

webhookHeaders.name: X-Subo-Delivery
webhookHeaders.desc: A unique event id, useful for deduplication

webhookHeaders.name: X-Subo-Signature
webhookHeaders.desc: sha256=<hmac hex> over the raw body

errorCodes.cause: Bad body, unknown block type, or two mutually exclusive script sources.
Out of bot credits for an AI call, or a feature above your tier.
A Creator-scoped key reaching for a project it does not own.
Wrong community or project id for this key.
Over the tier limit. Wait Retry-After seconds.
